author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: a puzzle piece with two round knobs held above two open hands (finger block over the wrist, thumb angled in toward the piece), mirrored about x=24. A first candidate drew the hands as plain U cups and did not read as hands. The rejected drawing had hook-shaped hands and a tiny piece.
omissions: The piece is upright rather than tilted and has knobs but no sockets (an inward socket would narrow the 12-unit piece below 8); individual fingers are merged into one rounded finger block.
drawing_plan: Piece square (18,10)-(30,22) with r4 knobs on top and right; hands: outer x=6 / inner x=14 lines to y=42 joined by an r4 finger arc (crest y=27); thumbs (14,36)-(19,32), mirrored.
lucide_reference: Lucide 'puzzle' (piece with round knobs) and 'hand' (open palm with angled thumb).
